log.msg: Read brief + past work + RefineQueue/RefinedCard/RefineCall. Plan: one small class Server/PromptAudit.mjs reusing RefineQueue.owner_text/find (the owner-prompt filter) and RefineCall.run (one no-tools call), with a v4 brief (task|question|statement|note). Pilot on one finished moderate session.

decision.chose: New small class PromptAudit (one file) that imports RefineQueue's prompt finder and RefineCall's one-call runner
decision.alternative: Add an --audit mode to RefineQueue; rejected because RefineQueue also writes Coverage cards, asks.jsonl and AskIndex filings, and the audit must write only its own audit.jsonl and file nothing

log.msg: Found: RefineQueue.owner_text passes ~2,600 machine transcripts in 30 days (clean-chunk calls, minion briefs inherit entrypoint claude-vscode, userType external). Fix in PromptAudit.human(): require turnOrigin==='human' or origin.kind==='human'. 30 days now = 20 sessions, 1,725 owner prompts. Pilot: session 7efd07d5 (2026-10-09, 22 prompts, $9.82 session).

decision.chose: audit.jsonl in the session's own folder, one structure line per prompt (transcript uuid + message uuid + line + timestamp) and one review line per item
decision.alternative: append to session.jsonl; rejected: record files are small (median 4 KB, p90 15 KB, max 406 KB over 2,435 files) and the audit would multiply them and mix judgments into the session's own history

log.msg: Pass 1 run 1 (brief v3 + note): 22 prompts, 402 items (193 task, 61 question, 135 statement, 13 note), $1.61, 2m00s at 3 parallel, biggest prompt 12.6k chars = $0.21. Spot-check of :172/:334/:644: no ask lost; misses = duplicate items for one want, one invented fix direction (:172 'make heading not full width'), named file AISessionDetail.js not tagged, rules kept as statements instead of doc updates. Folding in the owner's follow-up: file prompt-audit.jsonl, one line per prompt, kinds task|question|statement|update, v:1, tags, proposal states, agentic reviewer.

experiment.try: Brief v3+note on Haiku, pilot session 7efd07d5
experiment.measure: asks lost on 3 hand-checked prompts; cost per prompt
experiment.result: 0 lost; 1 invented direction, 1 duplicate; $0.073 a prompt

experiment.try: Brief tuned by wording only (one item per want, never invent a fix, update = standing rule), rerun on :172/:334/:644
experiment.result: round 2: invented fix gone, tags present, rules still statements; round 3 (clearer update line): 3 of 3 acceptable, $0.016 a short prompt

log.msg: Pass 1 v1 brief on all 22: 376 items (156 task, 60 question, 114 statement, 46 update), 148 tags, $1.34, 1m19s at 4 parallel. Pass 2 (Sonnet agent, Read/Grep/Glob/git log, 40 turns max) running.

decision.what: Owner follow-up: one line per prompt
decision.chose: prompt-audit.jsonl holds ONLY the Haiku line per prompt; the reviewer writes its own prompt-review.jsonl, also one line per prompt, keyed by the same transcript uuid + line
decision.alternative: reviewer lines in the same file; rejected so prompt-audit.jsonl stays exactly one line per prompt and the real-time pass can own it alone

log.msg: Moved the pilot's 17 added tasks (15 open, 2 done) into session-e00f55c9/prompt-review.jsonl as moved_task lines (script /tmp move-tasks.mjs, append-only); the 15 open ones stopped on sessions-and-tasks/task.jsonl through the item tool with a why naming the move. The brief said 18; the log holds 17 adds (one task covered two prompts).

experiment.try: Review round 1: Sonnet agent, Read/Grep/Glob/git, items + task records + window
experiment.result: $0.67, 89 s, 4 turns, 376 of 376 judged: 243 accepted, 116 rejected, 7 back-burner, 6 optional, 4 option; status 89 done, 79 partly, 39 open; 6 high loose ends. Weak: reasons are fragments, evidence mostly commit subjects, design statements rejected as 'design note'. Its feedback: pre-link candidate commits, list docs changed in the window, merge duplicates.

log.msg: Review round 2: node now pre-links up to 3 candidate commits per task/update (126 of 202 have one) and lists the 75 docs changed in the window; brief asks for a full-sentence why and keeps stated design decisions. Running.

experiment.try: Review round 2: node pre-links candidate commits + changed docs; brief asks a full-sentence why
experiment.measure: verdict counts vs round 1, reason quality
experiment.result: $0.87, 127 s, 2 turns; done 89 -> 186, rejected 116 -> 80, high loose ends 6 -> 26; reasons now sentences, decisions kept; over-credits done on one-word commit matches. Feedback: give cands their changed files, link the later item that settled an earlier one.

decision.chose: record the next change (chunks of ~100 items, cands with changed files, done needs a file or task path) in doc/prompt-audit.md and stop; model spend so far $4.59
decision.alternative: a third review round now (~$0.9); skipped to stay inside the $8 brief budget with my own turns counted
